notes: Pinned to gauss-state-space release tag v2.1.1 (bf827ae, GAUSS 26.1.4+) on 2026-10-17 (TVP-AIDS promotion Stage 1: adopt sslib v2.1.1, close P5). v2.1.1 is a patch release on v2.1.0 carrying 004c1be (the exact diffuse filters' diffuse test now runs in LDL-decorrelation units and counts diffuse directions from rank(P_inf_0), fixing the spurious mid-period diffuse update with a correlated/non-diagonal H that P5 case 3 found) and 717abb5 (ssFit/ssFitTVP convert the transformed-parameter covariance by the delta method instead of a second, untransformed CMLMT pass). Installed with scripts/sync_sslib.ps1 -SourceRepoPath <gauss-state-space checkout> -Commit bf827ae... (git archive of the tag commit, robocopy /MIR, lib/sslib.lcg rebuilt by build_lcg.ps1), after a hash-verified backup of the previous v2.1.0 install to C:\Users\eclow\Documents\sslib-backups\sslib-pre-v2.1.1-20261017-194100 (+ .sha256.txt). History: v2.1.0 (7d0e042) was pinned 2026-10-15 by P2 (decision gate D0, option A) as the first tag containing 5c300b1's diffuse-phase termination fix. verifiedFiles covers ALL src/*.src and *.sdf files of the pinned commit plus package.json: sha256 of the installed files as written by sync_sslib.ps1, so verify_sslib_pin.ps1 compares raw bytes, and it also flags any installed src/*.src or *.sdf file not listed here. pinnedVersion is checked against the installed package.json. Boundary: lib/sslib.lcg is NOT hashed -- it is generated at install time (sync_sslib.ps1 rebuilds it with build_lcg.ps1) and byte-for-byte determinism of that catalog has not been established, so a hash would be a false-alarm source rather than a check. A stale catalog surfaces as a GAUSS undefined-symbol error, and sync_sslib.ps1 regenerates it.
